How booking works

Every plan includes one dedicated hour per week. After you subscribe, we email you a private link to our calendar so you can book your sessions at times that suit you. Times are shown in your own time zone.

Cancelling

To receive a prorated refund for unused sessions, send us 30 days' written notice. See the full cancellation and refund terms.

To update your card or download invoices, open your billing portal.
